details: The Liquid sidechain successfully recovered 3,400 Bitcoin (BTC) into its federation wallet on September 7, following a recent reserve drain. While this partially restores assets backing its Bitcoin-linked token (L-BTC), withdrawal access remains unconfirmed and public bridge nodes are still experiencing a major outage. The recovery transaction confirmed at 16:09:25 UTC in Bitcoin block 965950.
title: Liquid Network Recovers 3,400 BTC After Security Incident

details: Bitcoin is at a crucial juncture around the $80,000 mark. After briefly surpassing $82,000, BTC fell back to around $78,500 on September 8. This decline is largely attributed to stronger-than-expected U.S. employment data, which increased the likelihood of a September Federal Reserve rate hike, thereby reducing appetite for risk assets. Despite consistent institutional inflows into spot Bitcoin ETFs, macro pressures have pushed Bitcoin into a battleground zone, with market participants watching for a decisive move above $82,000 or a sustained drop below $77,000.
title: Bitcoin Faces Critical $80K Level Amid Macro Headwinds

details: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy), a major corporate holder of Bitcoin, has once again paused its Bitcoin acquisitions. The company instead repurchased $176 million of its own stock ($STRC) and expanded its digital credit securities repurchase program from $1 billion to $2 billion. As of September 7, 2026, Strategy still holds 845,050 bitcoins, valued at over $66 billion.
title: Strategy Halts Bitcoin Buys Again, Shifts Focus to Stock Repurchases

details: Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR), a company focused on Bitcoin and Ethereum, announced total crypto and cash holdings of $15.7 billion as of September 7, 2026. This includes 5,929,198 ETH, valued at approximately $2,495 per ETH, with 5,067,309 ETH currently staked on their MAVAN platform. The company estimates projected annualized ETH staking rewards at $386 million.
title: Bitmine Immersion Technologies Reports $15.7 Billion in Crypto & Cash Holdings

details: The Ethereum Foundation's Protocol cluster has called for a broader ecosystem discussion on Ethereum's issuance policy, particularly regarding proposals to burn part of validator rewards (EIP-8363). This debate highlights a tension between maintaining high staking yields for validators and mitigating dilution for unstaked ETH holders. Currently, 42.9 million ETH (35.13% of supply) is staked, meaning unstaked holders bear dilution without receiving rewards.
title: Ethereum's Supply Debate Intensifies: Staking Yields vs. ETH Value

details: The Robinhood Chain has witnessed a significant surge in activity, with over $700 million worth of Ethereum (ETH) tokens bridged from the Ethereum blockchain. This represents a 150% increase in bridge deposits over the last month, signaling growing interest and cross-chain activity on the layer-2 network.
title: Robinhood Chain Sees $700 Million ETH Bridged, Activity Jumps 150%
